prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-fidelity stylized 3D concert image featuring a clearly adult fictional female-presenting avatar in a dynamic mid-air jump, forward-leaning and action-oriented. Give the avatar two high space buns, black hair with vibrant neon-green roots and highlights, light blue-gray eyes, and a calm focused expression. Dress the avatar in an oversized neon-lime green short-sleeved T-shirt and matching oversized shorts with fictional black graffiti graphics, stacked chunky silver chrome chain necklaces, a silver abstract pendant, monochromatic neon-green high-top sneakers, and mid-calf ribbed socks. Place the avatar on a futuristic concert or festival mainstage with dramatic neon-green volumetric lighting, laser beams, glowing floor panels, vibrant green haze, digital energy effects, and a silhouetted guitarist on a raised platform in the distance. Use a low-angle vertical composition, motion blur, realistic material detail, and a game-cinematic 3D render aesthetic. Keep the character wholly fictional with no real performer likeness, name, logo, or trademark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, real performer name, real logo, trademark, watermark, plastic materials, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, broken motion blur, unreadable graffiti
